scope: Real Electron, actual hooks/renderer with synthetic Main protocol events; no provider/terminal
checks: interleaved token and reasoning events stay in one actual hook message
reasoning retains its own content block
live and legacy rows have no isolated first-character paragraphs
composer starts at a shorter input height
focus preview describes the selected turn
preview contains prose rather than serialized state
jump to a previous turn pauses automatic following
continued streaming does not pull the reader away from history
final streamed result is deduplicated with its table intact
finished duplicate streaming text is removed as a whole
ArrowDown moves focus to the next turn
